reviewerSelfCorrection.statement: ALJ-V2-SF1 is a defect I did not catch. I reviewed v2 in the previous cycle and returned ACCEPT 0/0; Codex returned REJECT 0/1 on this finding. The gap is real and I confirmed it here from primary sources: D-111 line 30 reads 'Claude advisory CLAUDE-V7-A-1 travels as honesty work', and frozen v2 carried 8 obligations with no OBL-ADVISORY-HONESTY and no summary.honesty key at all.
reviewerSelfCorrection.whyIMissedIt: In my v2 review I opened D-111 and grepped its body specifically for the hostile-goldens standing, which I found and verified. I did not grep it for advisories. That was inconsistent with my own method elsewhere in this same wave — I checked traveling advisories explicitly at D-115 (sarif), D-110 (sdk), and D-125 (platform-tcb), and each time the join carried a matching OBL-ADVISORY-HONESTY. The anti-lockstep join was the one place I checked the row-specific standing but not the advisory standing, so the absent obligation did not register as absent.

priorFindingDisposition: One finding was outstanding against v2: ALJ-V2-SF1 (Codex, SHOULD-FIX). It is real, it is landed, and its landing was verified from primary sources rather than from the subject's own account. My own v2 verdict was ACCEPT 0/0 and missed it; see reviewerSelfCorrection.
observationsNotFindings: CARRIED FORWARD FROM MY v2 REVIEW — D-121 RECORDING-KIND LABEL. OBL-AL3-CORE-ROLLBACK still says self-update-repair-contract.v3 'is recorded at D-121 as DR-110 leftover T2-02'. I re-checked: D-121's heading reads 'accepted design-contract successor candidate', and its full entry contains zero occurrences of 'T2-02' or 'leftover', whereas D-124 and D-125 headings do use the leftover-T2-02 label. The locus D-121 is right; the kind label is not. Still not a finding — the obligation stays leftoverDesign true, the subject expressly refuses to claim v3 covers AL-3 core-release-byte rollback, the property cited from that contract is verified in its own bytes, and the error runs conservative. The reason is byte-identical to v2 and outside this successor's stated scope, which was strictly to land ALJ-V2-SF1 without touching the three leftovers. COORDINATOR NOTE: this is now the second cycle carrying it; worth correcting whenever this obligation is next legitimately in scope.

RESOLVED SINCE v2. The purpose clause I flagged last cycle — 'Replace predecessor self-version closing sentence with the generic form', which had no antecedent because v1 had no predecessor block — is gone. v3's purpose is specific and accurate to what it did: 'Land ALJ-V2-SF1. Add OBL-ADVISORY-HONESTY leftoverDesign false naming CLAUDE-V7-A-1 as traveling per D-111. Preserve the three leftoverDesign-true obligations.'

authorityClaim opens 'v3 remasures after D-167/D-169/D-185 and lands ALJ-V2-SF1'. Strictly v3 takes no new measurement — its head equals v2's head, a11a041 — so 'remasures' is carried phrasing rather than a fresh measurement claim. Not misleading: the pins genuinely are the current live pins, and predecessorV2.role states plainly that v2 was measured at the same a11a041, so the artifact is transparent that both sit at one head. The purpose field carries the precise account.

The advisory landed here is my own CLAUDE-V7-A-1 from the v7 contract review, whose suggestion was that a later successor should 'either fold them or record once why the class is being carried'. v3 takes the record-not-fold route and says so explicitly. That is consistent with the standing instruction not to discharge it, and I note the provenance for transparency rather than as a concern.

decision.summaryForCoordinator: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Twenty attacks run, twenty refuted. ALJ-V2-SF1 is a genuine defect that I missed when I accepted v2 at 0/0 and Codex caught — I confirmed it independently: D-111 records 'Claude advisory CLAUDE-V7-A-1 travels as honesty work', and frozen v2 carried no OBL-ADVISORY-HONESTY and no summary.honesty key. v3 lands it exactly and only: one obligation added at leftoverDesign false, summary.honesty created, and the three leftoverDesign-true obligations byte-identical to v2 with nothing removed and no flag changed. Every clause of the new reason verifies against primary sources — D-111's sentence, the ADVISORY-NON-BLOCKING severity in the v7 review, and all three booked-class range tokens verbatim — and all discharge/fold language is negative. The diff is surgical and executionRoutesVerbatim is untouched. One structurally novel point checked and clean: v3 is a repair successor at the SAME head as v2, and the artifact states both predecessors at their correct and different heads. The D-121 recording-kind label observation from my v2 review is carried forward unresolved, since correcting it was outside this successor's scope; it is now in its second cycle and worth fixing when that obligation is next legitimately in scope.
